phase_summary.summary: ROCA is the active research branch; main was restored after accidental merge; historical branches were merged into ROCA and archived/deleted remotely.
Stimulus-only and label/task protocol baselines established; old literature-level LOSO difficulty was confirmed in this project-specific protocol.
EMG-only, expanded EMG, nonlinear EMG, and augmented EMG probes did not rescue strict LOSO residual emotion recognition.
Raw EEG residual/deep attempts, model-asset checks, residual training, multitask/sign auxiliary and oracle diagnostics did not provide a locked-gate global LOSO solution.
Old gaussian_0p10 evidence was promising but non-comparable; clean locked rerun showed Gaussian augmentation does not fix LOSO.
Subject calibration/k-shot/bias correction helped more than blind global models, but this changes the claim from pure zero-calibration LOSO to calibrated/personalized/adaptation-assisted recognition.
Strict LOSO global raw EEG/EMG residual decoding remains unsupported by locked gates. The dominant issue is subject calibration/domain shift plus weak transferable residual identifiability.
